title: Hamilton's equations, the Levi-Civita connection and gauge fields arise from commutators

statements.text: In a noncommutative calculus whose derivations are commutators, Hamilton's equations, the structure of the Levi-Civita connection and generalizations of electromagnetism related to gauge theory arise.

sources.quote: This paper shows how gauge theoretic structures arise in a noncommutative calculus where the derivations are generated by commutators
